name: 🌲 Oaklands [👽 ALIENS]
desc:
🌳 Create a tycoon empire in this sandbox game. Chop trees, process lumber, mine rocks and ores, create amazing buildings, and more! There are endless opportunities, from creating complex automated machines, to creating an epic castle of mystery. Have fun earning, exploring, and creating!

NEW UPDATE - PROGRESSION REVAMP:
    Reworked progression, stuff costs more, materials give more!
    New tier 4 machinery!
    New mining & chopping minigames!
    A TON of QOL Additions!
    A bunch of bug fixes!
    … SO MUCH MORE!!!!

🛠️ Oaklands is still in development, there may be unexpected issues. Sorry for the inconvenience!
